hockey_player.evidence: The figure possesses the necessary equipment like a stick, helmet, and skates, but the rigid T-pose with the stick dangling vertically completely breaks the illusion of a hockey player.

toy.evidence: The oversized head, thick cylindrical limbs, and blocky extremities strongly suggest a plastic toy figure, though the dark colors muddy the read at a distance.

answer.best_row: All rows display the same flawed T-pose walk cycle, making none particularly better for reading as a hockey player.
changes: pose -> change from T-pose to a forward-leaning hockey stance
arms -> bend elbows and bring hands together to grip the stick with both hands
stick -> angle the stick diagonally across the body with the blade on the ice
colors -> lighten the deep blue jersey to improve visibility against dark backgrounds at small scales
worst: The T-pose with outstretched arms prevents any read of hockey action.
The stick is held in a single hand pointing straight down, looking like a crutch.
The dark blue jersey blends into the shadows and background when downscaled.
works: The chunky, exaggerated proportions effectively communicate the toy concept.
The bright orange accents on the skates and blade draw the eye and contrast well.
The simple, rounded geometry of the helmet and body fits the arcade style.
